style: 克制、精确而略带俏皮的单色点阵 Logo Reveal。暖近黑画布上，规则点阵先组装纸盒，再让猫探出、眨眼并补全尾巴，最后无缝锁定到用户提供的原始白色 PNG。
shot_brief: 0.18 秒后背景点阵苏醒；Logo 透明度遮罩内的点先从下向上建立纸盒，再以轻微弹性让猫从盒中探出并眨眼一次。约 2.6 秒时，激活方向改变为沿右侧向下补全尾巴，形成唯一一次节奏中断。随后点阵收束，原始 PNG 完整覆盖并静止定格到结尾。

customize.reuse: 保留 logo-outro 的单镜头组装、局部辉光和最终锁定结构。
replace: 删除模板中的示例 SVG 图形
删除模板品牌配色与远程字体
hand_authored_gaps: 用原 PNG alpha 遮罩生成规则点阵层
用同一 PNG 的裁切副本分别表现盒体、左右盒盖、猫和尾巴
用两个背景色遮罩完成一次眨眼
用原始 PNG 完成最终无损锁定

phases.motion: ambient grid fades and scales from 0.985 to 1 with expo.out; a localized glow begins behind the hero
bottom-up clip reveal on the box-only dot mask; clean box base settles from y=34; left and right flap crops rotate inward with different durations
cat-only dot mask reveals upward; clean cat crop rises from y=86 and scale=0.96 with back.out(1.35), then settles; the eyes blink once from 2.16 to 2.34
tail-only dot mask reveals from right to left, then the clean tail crop rotates 7 degrees into place with circ.out
dot proxies contract to 0.82 and fade while the unmodified PNG fades from 0 to 1 at scale 1; one soft glow pulse resolves behind it
complete original PNG stays fully visible and still; background grid performs one finite low-amplitude breath; no fade to black

technical.runtime: one paused GSAP timeline, synchronous construction
